ARTIFACT SEARCH RESULT (2026-08-07) — the named artifacts EXIST; they were never local-only.

Searched all worktrees and every branch. Both files this ticket references are present:
* on disk at /Users/joeoakhart/impl-10ae-verifier-ctx/docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py and .../diag_runaway_matrix.py
* in git, ADDED by commit 556708771e67ef6b73ab2c49203b657d5529611e ('Bank verifier AC verdicts; scale floor; read memo', 2026-08-06, RebarBotNava)

Branch containment: 556708771e is reachable ONLY from branch impl-10ae-verifier-ctx. Verified NOT an ancestor of origin/main.

So the earlier triage's premise — 'the named artifacts do not exist on main, so the capture may have been intentionally local-only' — is wrong in its conclusion. The capture was committed, not local-only; the commit simply never landed. The disposition question is therefore not 'was this intentional?' but 'should impl-10ae-verifier-ctx's diagnostic artifacts be landed on main, or are they a working-branch aid that main does not need?'

Worth noting the general hazard this exposes: a ticket citing artifacts by path is only verifiable against the branch that holds them, and a reviewer checking main will conclude they were never produced.

WHY LAND rather than de-cite (the question the previous comment left open):
1. `docs/experiments/` on main ALREADY holds this exact artifact shape — paired live-diagnostic driver + findings write-up: `ed6d_live_recovery.py`/`ed6d-live-recovery.md`, `f6fc_live_memo_nudge.py`/`f6fc-live-memo-nudge.md`. These match an established convention, not a one-off.

They are reusable, not scratch: both are parameterised over ticket / ref / step-floor list / trial count, and they depend only on surfaces that still exist on main — `pai_tools.{filesystem_tools,grounding_tools,rebar_tools}` and `completion._VERIFY_MIN_STEPS` (`completion.py:84`). The budget-anchoring matrix stays re-runnable against any future change to the verifier's step floor, which matters because 2948 changes exactly that.

NOTHING ELSE from `556708771e` was dragged along. That commit also carries 2948's implementation (`completion_banking.py`, the criteria-scaled step floor, the path-normalized read memo, schema + test changes); all of it belongs to 2948's own review and was deliberately excluded. comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
STILL REPRODUCING ON CURRENT MAIN — 2026-08-07, after the tree was updated.

The operator asked whether updating from origin/main would resolve the completion-verifier runaway. It does NOT. Measured on a tree containing every change merged this session (through 0767c38ebb), with the global rebar install resolving to exactly origin/main (0 commits behind):

* `4c2b` close — verifier aborted a runaway tool-call loop at **66 requests**, tripping `max_consecutive_repeat=12`. Reported by the agent as 'same class as the bf31 loop this ticket came from'.
* `dbb2` close — same abort.
* Earlier in the same session, the environment-fixes agent hit it on **three of four** close attempts, costing roughly 20 minutes.

Both closes ultimately SUCCEEDED, so the runaway guard is working as a backstop — but the loop it is catching is still occurring, which is this ticket's subject. Note ticket 46a2 was closed earlier today as a duplicate on the reasoning that the runaway guard is live (`_runaway_guard_toolsets` raising `RunawayToolLoopError` at src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py:144-197). That reasoning was about the GUARD; it does not mean the underlying loop is fixed, and this evidence shows it is not.

Useful discriminator for the investigation: the loop is NOT universal — many closes this session completed without tripping it. It clustered on `4c2b` and `dbb2`, both of which are TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE tickets whose acceptance criteria reference import machinery, sys.path behaviour and collection semantics rather than a single source symbol. That is consistent with the verifier hunting across many files for a criterion with no single obvious anchor — which points at context pre-selection (the same remedy direction recorded on 7c58 before it closed) rather than at the guard.

Also relevant: the artifacts this ticket cites (docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py, diag_runaway_transcript.py) are NOW ON MAIN as of 87b8023e31, so the measurement tooling is verifiable against main rather than stranded on a branch.

# Land the completion-verifier runaway diagnostic artifacts on main

## Context / Problem
This ticket's own findings — and its ACCEPTANCE clause — cite
`docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md`, `docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py`
and `docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py` as the durable record of the measurement. Those
three files were committed in `556708771e` on the branch `impl-10ae-verifier-ctx`, which is
NOT an ancestor of `origin/main`. So on main the cited paths do not exist and a reviewer
checking this ticket's evidence concludes the measurement was never produced. The ticket is
currently unverifiable against main through no fault of the measurement itself.

## Approach
Land the three artifacts on main, unchanged, as their own change — nothing else from
`556708771e` (that commit also carries the 2948 implementation: `completion_banking.py`, the
scaled step floor, the read memo, schema and test changes, all of which belong to 2948's own
review, not here).

Landing rather than de-citing is the right call on the evidence:
- `docs/experiments/` on main already holds exactly this artifact shape — paired live-diagnostic
  driver + findings write-up (`ed6d_live_recovery.py` + `ed6d-live-recovery.md`,
  `f6fc_live_memo_nudge.py` + `f6fc-live-memo-nudge.md`). These match that established
  convention.
- Both scripts are reusable, not throwaway: they are parameterised over ticket / ref / step
  floors / trial count, and they depend only on surfaces that still exist on main —
  `rebar.llm.pai_tools.{filesystem_tools,grounding_tools,rebar_tools}` and
  `rebar.llm.completion._VERIFY_MIN_STEPS` (`completion.py:84`). The budget-anchoring matrix is
  re-runnable against any future change to the verifier's step floor.
- They are content-free by construction: raw transcripts are written outside the repo and are
  never committed, which is why the findings doc records only aggregates.

`docs/` is outside the `ruff check src tests` / `ruff format --check src tests` lint gate, so
the scripts land byte-identical to the reviewed originals (as the existing experiment scripts
in that directory already do — they carry `print()` calls for the same reason).
`docs/experiments/README.md` indexes only the remediation-plan EXP1..EXP-R11 series and does
not list the later live-diagnostic artifacts, so it needs no edit.

## Scope
- `docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md` (new, from `556708771e`)
- `docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py` (new, from `556708771e`)
- `docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py` (new, from `556708771e`)

No source, test, or configuration file changes. Nothing else from `556708771e` is included.

## Testing
No new testable behaviour: this change adds documentation and opt-in, local-only diagnostic
drivers that are never imported by the package or executed by CI. The relevant check is that
the added files do not perturb the existing gates, which the acceptance criteria below verify
directly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] All three cited paths exist on the change's tree — verified by
      `test -f docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md -a -f docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py -a -f docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py`
      exiting 0.
- [x] The added files are byte-identical to their `556708771e` originals — verified by
      `git diff --quiet 556708771e HEAD -- docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py`
      exiting 0.
- [x] The change adds ONLY those three files — verified by
      `test "$(git diff --name-only origin/main HEAD | grep -vc '^docs/experiments/diag')" -eq 0`.
- [x] Both scripts resolve their imports against main — verified by
      `python -c "import ast,sys; [ast.parse(open(p).read()) for p in ('docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py','docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py')]"`
      exiting 0 and by `grep -q '_VERIFY_MIN_STEPS' src/rebar/llm/completion.py`.
- [x] `make lint` and `make typecheck` still pass on the change's tree.
- [x] The ticket's own findings comments and this description cite only paths that exist on
      main once the change merges — verified by re-reading the ticket after the merge.
